text:
Hieroglyphs of love
Natalia vanished
stonecutter at the primal work
time the grand Methodist
a herd assaults with waving voices
turning toward his face
to his cotton arm
soft beardless armchair
possessed by the black and light:
“In the homeland it is beautiful...”

translation.title: Hieroglyphs of Love
